name: io.github.agent402-dev/a402-pay-mcp
description: Pay x402 APIs on Solana (USDC, A402) from your own wallet within your limits. Refuses by default.

environmentVariables.name: X402_KEYPAIR_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Path to the payment wallet key file (Solana CLI JSON). Without it nothing is paid.

environmentVariables.name: X402_ALLOWED_DOMAINS
environmentVariables.description: Allowed domains, comma-separated. Empty: every payment refused.

environmentVariables.name: X402_TRUSTED_PAY_TO
environmentVariables.description: Trusted recipient addresses, comma-separated. Empty: every payment refused.

environmentVariables.name: X402_MAX_USD
environmentVariables.description: Max USDC per payment in USD (default 0.05)

environmentVariables.name: X402_MAX_USD_PER_DAY
environmentVariables.description: Max USDC per UTC day in USD (default 1)

environmentVariables.name: X402_MAX_A402_ATOMIC
environmentVariables.description: Max A402 per payment, in A402 smallest units (1 A402 = 1,000,000). Not set: A402 refused.

environmentVariables.name: X402_MAX_A402_PER_DAY_ATOMIC
environmentVariables.description: Max A402 per UTC day, in A402 smallest units (1 A402 = 1,000,000). Not set: A402 refused.

environmentVariables.name: X402_CONFIRM_ABOVE_USD
environmentVariables.description: Ask a human at or above this USDC amount (USD). Default off.

environmentVariables.name: X402_CONFIRM_ABOVE_A402_ATOMIC
environmentVariables.description: Ask a human at or above this A402 amount (A402 smallest units). Default off.

environmentVariables.name: X402_RPC_URL
environmentVariables.description: Solana RPC URL used to build payment transactions

environmentVariables.name: X402_HISTORY_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Local payment log (JSONL). Daily limits are counted from this file.
